name: finance_attachment_paths_in_document_v2
definition:
CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION private.finance_attachment_paths_in_document_v2(p_document jsonb)
 RETURNS SETOF text
 LANGUAGE sql
 IMMUTABLE
 SET search_path TO ''
AS $function$
  select distinct path_value #>> '{}'
  from (
    select pg_catalog.jsonb_path_query(
      coalesce(p_document, '{}'::jsonb),
      '$.**.path'::pg_catalog.jsonpath
    ) as path_value
    union all
    select pg_catalog.jsonb_path_query(
      coalesce(p_document, '{}'::jsonb),
      '$.**.storagePath'::pg_catalog.jsonpath
    ) as path_value
    union all
    select pg_catalog.jsonb_path_query(
      coalesce(p_document, '{}'::jsonb),
      '$.**.storage_path'::pg_catalog.jsonpath
    ) as path_value
  ) referenced_path
  where pg_catalog.jsonb_typeof(path_value) = 'string'
    and nullif(path_value #>> '{}', '') is not null
$function$

name: finance_is_current_document_attachment_path_v3
definition:
CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION private.finance_is_current_document_attachment_path_v3(p_storage_path text, p_tenant_id uuid, p_record_type text, p_environment text)
 RETURNS boolean
 LANGUAGE sql
 IMMUTABLE
 SET search_path TO ''
AS $function$
  select coalesce(
    (
      (path_parts.parts)[1] = p_record_type
      and (path_parts.parts)[2] = p_environment
      and pg_catalog.cardinality(path_parts.parts) >= 8
      and nullif((path_parts.parts)[7], '') is not null
    )
    or (
      (path_parts.parts)[1] = p_tenant_id::text
      and (path_parts.parts)[2] = p_record_type
      and (path_parts.parts)[3] = p_environment
      and pg_catalog.cardinality(path_parts.parts) >= 9
      and nullif((path_parts.parts)[8], '') is not null
    ),
    false
  )
  from (
    select storage.foldername(p_storage_path) as parts
  ) path_parts
$function$
args: p_storage_path text, p_tenant_id uuid, p_record_type text, p_environment text

name: finance_is_current_finance_attachment_path_v3
definition:
CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION private.finance_is_current_finance_attachment_path_v3(p_storage_path text)
 RETURNS boolean
 LANGUAGE sql
 IMMUTABLE
 SET search_path TO ''
AS $function$
  select coalesce(
    (
      (path_parts.parts)[1] in (
        'expense_requests',
        'invoices',
        'bills',
        'vouchers'
      )
      and (path_parts.parts)[2] in ('production', 'test')
      and pg_catalog.cardinality(path_parts.parts) >= 8
      and nullif((path_parts.parts)[7], '') is not null
    )
    or (
      (path_parts.parts)[2] in (
        'expense_requests',
        'invoices',
        'bills',
        'vouchers'
      )
      and (path_parts.parts)[3] in ('production', 'test')
      and pg_catalog.cardinality(path_parts.parts) >= 9
      and nullif((path_parts.parts)[1], '') is not null
      and nullif((path_parts.parts)[8], '') is not null
    ),
    false
  )
  from (
    select storage.foldername(p_storage_path) as parts
  ) path_parts
$function$
